android.desc: Win7 Simu is an interactive simulator inspired by classic Windows operating systems. Experience the beautiful and elegant interface with functional simulated apps, personalization options, and full-touch support. 🌟 Features ✅ A nostalgic Windows-inspired interface Enjoy a familiar look and feel with a boot animation, login screen, desktop, taskbar, start menu, and more—all faithfully recreated to the original designs of the Windows interface. ✅ Fully functional simulated programs Try classic apps like Calculator, Notepad, WordPad, Internet Explorer, Media Player, and Snipping Tool—all simulated with real functionality! ✅ Themes and customization Beyond Windows 7, you can explore themes inspired by Windows 2000, Vista, Windows 10, Windows 11, and more. Plus, create your own style with the exclusive Theme Studio! ✅ And more to explore ... There's much more hidden inside! Try it out and relive the golden days of using your childhood operating systems. 🌐 External links - Developer website: https://visnalize.com - Changelog: https://visnalize.com/win7simu/changelog - Frequently asked questions: https://visnalize.com/win7simu/faq - Did you know: https://visnalize.com/win7simu/dyk ⚠ Disclaimer Win7 Simu is an independent fan project for entertainment purposes. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft Corporation. Windows is a registered trademark of Microsoft Corporation. All third-party assets and their licences are credited at https://visnalize.com/win7simu/credits.

quotes.text:
I admit, I'm pretty dense when it comes to copyright/licensing topics, so here's the question: Is it legal to build websites/apps that simulate the Windows operating system and use icons and images which are copyrighted by Microsoft? I have seen quite some such as these webs/apps:

* http://windows93.net/

* https://98.js.org/

* https://winxp.vercel.app/

* https://desk.glitchy.website/

* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lr_soft.windows98simulator

* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.visnalize.win7simu

* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MrToddy.Win10BUG

* https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jesusdigitalrd.jpcsim

... any many more you can find on Play Store.
quotes.title: Ask HN: Is it legal to simulate a product? (Windows in this case)
